title: The 200-Run Question: Which Conditions Make Delhi Capitals a High-Scoring Side?
dek: Two hundred used to be a winning total. Which conditions make Delhi Capitals a high-scoring side, and how safe is a big total now?
excerpt: Delhi Capitals have reached 200 more often since 2024 than before it. Across the league, a 200-plus total batting first still usually wins, but it is no longer a guarantee.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: DC have posted {{ev:t200-all}} totals of 200 or more, {{ev:t200-rec}} of them since 2024.
{{ev:t200-recshare}} of Delhi Capitals' innings since 2024 have reached 200.
Batting first, DC have won {{ev:t200-twin}} of matches in which they made 200 or more; the league figure is {{ev:t200-lgwin}}.

sections.heading: When Two Hundred Became Normal
body: For most of IPL history a score of 200 was a statement. Across the league, {{ev:t200-lg-e1}} of innings reached it between 2008 and 2023; since 2024 the figure is {{ev:t200-lg-e2}}. The question for Delhi Capitals is when and where they get there.
DC have posted {{ev:t200-all}} totals of 200 or more in all, {{ev:t200-rec}} of them since 2024. In that recent window {{ev:t200-recshare}} of their innings reached the mark.

sections.heading: Is Two Hundred Still Safe?
body: Across the league, sides that posted 200 or more batting first won {{ev:t200-lgwin}} of the time.
Delhi Capitals have won {{ev:t200-twin}} of their {{ev:t200-twinn}} such matches. The home-and-away split shows where those totals came from.

sections.heading: Conditions That Produce Big Totals
body: Big totals cluster at certain grounds and in certain seasons, so the home venue matters. The split between home and away 200-plus totals shows how much of Delhi Capitals' high scoring depends on familiar conditions.
A side that posts big totals only at home has a venue advantage, not necessarily a batting one.

sections.heading: Big Totals Can Hide Bowling Problems
body: A team that regularly needs 200 to win is also a team that concedes a lot. The high-scoring identity can mask a bowling attack that would lose more often at par totals.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Plan for Two Hundred, Defend One-Eighty
body: Delhi Capitals should treat 200 as a realistic target in good conditions, not a safety margin. The league data says it still wins most of the time, but not often enough to relax.
The more useful planning number is the total the bowling can defend on a normal day, which the defending-totals analysis in this series addresses.
